$schema.description: The schema this file follows (for editors; the runner ignores it).

name.description: Unique, lower-case with dashes; `ac fixtures --only <name>` runs it.

description.description: What a reviewer should see in the views, and how each expected number was worked out.

pinned.description: Numbers copied from the program's own output: why that is acceptable here.

script.description: The commands, run in order on a fresh session.

errors.description: Mistakes: each must be refused with a message and leave the document unchanged.

views.description: Camera views rendered for the gallery and the visual goldens.

title: Feature fixture
description:
A feature fixture: a script of commands with hand-worked expectations, mistakes that must be
refused, and the views a person looks at.

params.description:
Its parameters. `{tmp}` in a text becomes the fixture's scratch folder, `{assets}` the
assets folder.

expect.description:
What its result must hold: numbers within the tolerance, objects key by key (keys not named
are not checked), `{"$contains": [items]}` for an array holding matching items.

pinned.description: Numbers copied from the program's own output: why.
